performanceAdjudication.interpretation: CPU-only conservative calibration is 9.48% faster in its own ABBA cohort. Independent frozen-page cohorts show 5.15% and 7.02% shorter conservative entry medians, with no material total-stop gain. All original samples retained. Original conservative memory comparison is ineligible because one stopped sample is absent; the complete six-run supplement shows stopped renderer working-set median +27.53% (+551059456 bytes), and entry longest-frame median +10.46%. Initial replication stopped working set is bimodal and its median is also higher. Four separate heap/forced-GC diagnostic runs show post-GC main live heap approximately equal (-0.19%) and worker heap equal; those inspected/forced runs cannot establish natural memory recovery. Do not promote or publish this candidate until ordinary exit-memory behavior is resolved.
